channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: Coinbase wins final OCC approval for national trust charter
item.description: The OCC has made Coinbase’s national trust charter effective, putting its planned institutional crypto custody business under a federal framework.

item.title: U.S. order targets MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
item.description: A FinCEN order will bar U.S. institutions from sending funds to or from MEXC after Treasury alleged at least $16 billion in illicit flows over five years.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview helped enable $6.34bn hack
item.description: Binance says a fake job interview helped hackers reach its wallet systems before $6.34bn in crypto was taken, exposing a months-long breach of exchange security.

item.title: FBI links $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor group stole more than $6 billion from Binance and urges crypto services to block wallets as laundering moves to ether.

item.title: FBI ties $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance and is urging crypto firms to block linked wallets as the funds move into Ether for laundering.

item.title: FBI links $6B Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance and urges crypto services to block wallets used to move the funds after the record-setting theft.

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $76,000 as AI stocks slide
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $76,000 as a sharp AI-stock selloff hit risk appetite, triggering more than $1 billion in crypto liquidations and exposing market ties.

item.title: How sunswap can swap tokens without a direct pool
item.description: When two tokens lack a shared pool, sunswap can route a trade through other assets or liquidity sources, though each hop can affect the final amount.

item.title: Binance says October breach affected $6.34 billion in crypto
item.description: Binance says attackers moved $6.34 billion in crypto through its wallet systems, with $2.85 billion frozen or intercepted and user losses covered.

item.title: Aztec’s Tierra V6 upgrade speeds up private apps
item.description: Aztec's Tierra V6 upgrade roughly doubles private proof speed and speeds Ethereum deposits, while fixing a critical flaw in the network's earlier version.

item.title: North Korea rejects FBI claim over $6 billion Binance hack
item.description: North Korea denies responsibility for Binance’s $6 billion hack, while the FBI blames its TraderTraitor group and urges crypto firms to block linked funds.

item.title: Binance reopens bitcoin and ether withdrawals after $6.3B theft
item.description: Binance has reopened bitcoin and ether withdrawals in phases after a $6.3 billion theft, saying it has replaced 95% of the stolen assets as users regain access to funds.

item.title: FBI links $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29, as the exchange restores withdrawals and investigators track the funds.

item.title: FBI links North Korea to $6B Binance theft
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance, and warns that the attackers are moving funds into Ethereum before laundering them.

item.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of funds lost in $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance says it has replaced 90% of assets taken in a $6.3 billion breach, while withdrawals remain paused and the attack investigation continues.

item.title: Binance says $6.3 billion stolen in suspected North Korea-linked hack
item.description: Binance says a breach drained about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets; analysts link it to North Korea, while the exchange says it will cover users’ losses.

item.title: Binance pauses withdrawals after $6.3 billion security breach
item.description: Binance says a security breach may have affected about $6.3 billion in assets, prompting it to pause withdrawals while it works to recover funds for users.

item.title: HSBC brings RedCoin stablecoin to PayMe users in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC launched RedCoin on PayMe in Hong Kong, opening its HKD stablecoin to more than 3.3 million users in stages for transfers and merchant payments.

item.title: Janus Henderson launches Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
item.description: Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launched JQQQ on Stellar, giving eligible non-US investors a blockchain-native fund tied to the Nasdaq-100 under a Nasdaq license.

item.title: Aviva and Ripple put £22bn sterling fund on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple have put a tokenized share class of a £22bn sterling liquidity fund on the XRP Ledger, widening access to on-chain fund holdings.
